subject: Compliance roadmap: evidence stack and audit prep
messages:
From: Angela Miles <angela.miles@auditcorp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: acme-secops@acme.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit intake: scope and initial evidence request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for agreeing to coordinate with AuditCorp on the upcoming ISO 27001 / FedRAMP readiness check for Acme. To get the intake moving quickly, can you confirm the following?

1) Scope: are we covering Hosted API only, or do we include Dedicated and Private deployments for Acme's contract?
2) Control owners: can you provide a CSV (name, role, email, control areas) we can use for sampling?
3) Evidence matrix: please populate the attached initial_intake_template.xlsx with links to artifacts (policy docs, configs, screenshots).
4) SIG/CAIQ: do you have a draft SIG response or a location where your CAIQ answers live?
5) Timing: target audit kickoff week is 2027-07-18 — what internal timelines are realistic for evidence collection?

If easier, we can do a 30-minute scoping call early next week.

Thanks,
Angela Miles
Senior Principal, AuditCorp
(Attachment: initial_intake_template.xlsx)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Angela Miles <angela.miles@auditcorp.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit intake: scope and initial evidence request

Hi Angela —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below:

1) Scope: Acme has Hosted API in production and is evaluating Dedicated for Q4. For this engagement they requested Hosted + any customer-configured network controls (i.e., if there are VPC configs tied to Acme we should include those artifacts).
2) Control owners: Neha will own coordinating the CSV and mapping to our policy owners. Expect a first pass by 2027-07-07.
3) Evidence matrix: I'll upload a pre-populated sheet (evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx) to the shared drive and attach scoping_decision.pdf explaining what we've included/excluded for this intake.
4) SIG/CAIQ: we keep a living CAIQ in our compliance drive; I'll share a read-only link. There are a few open questions on third-party crypto libraries that we'll flag.
5) Timing: 2027-07-07 for owner mappings and primary artifacts, 2027-07-12 for a final pre-kickoff review by our compliance team. Kickoff week 2027-07-18 still works.

Proposed: 30-min scoping call on Mon 2027-06-28 10:00 PT. If that works for you I'll send an invite.

Attaching: security_scoping_notes.pdf (high-level decisions) — will follow with the matrix upload.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: security_scoping_notes.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Angela Miles <angela.miles@auditcorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit intake: scope and initial evidence request

Adding a few technical clarifications from the platform side:

- For FedRAMP-relevant controls we should include our key management diagrams and HSM usage notes (where customer-managed keys are in scope vs. our managed keys). I will pull the KMS architecture diagram and a short narrative.
- Sampling: AuditCorp — when you say sampling for config items, do you want point-in-time snapshots or version history? We store audit logs for 13 months (config change IDs + file diffs).
- For Hosted+VPC items: some network ACLs are created per-tenant; we can redact tenant IDs but will provide exemplars.

I'll attach the working evidence matrix I'm building (evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx). Neha — can you confirm who will be the technical contact for backup/restore and for encryption evidence?

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Platform Security
(Attachment: evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx)

From: Angela Miles <angela.miles@auditcorp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit intake: scope and initial evidence request

Thanks Marcus — helpful. Quick answers:

- Sampling: point-in-time snapshots with verifiable checksums are preferred. Version history is useful for change controls but not required for every artifact.
- KMS/HSM: provide the architecture diagram + a statement of control ownership (who manages keys for Acme instances).
- Network exemplars are fine; redact tenant IDs as you suggested.

Request: please upload the CSV of control owners and the preliminary evidence matrix to the shared drive by 2027-07-07. Once we receive that we will issue the formal evidence request checklist and schedule the intake kickoff.

Intake form (fill this for each control area): https://auditcorp.example.com/intake/form/ACME-2027

I'll plan to join the scoping call on Mon 2027-06-28 10:00 PT.

Regards,
Angela
(Attachment: none)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Audit intake status and immediate asks (for Acme)

Team — quick internal summary and owners so we can hit the 07/07 target: 

- Neha: assemble CSV of control owners (name, role, email, control groups) — due 2027-07-07. Put draft in the drive folder and notify Angela.
- Marcus: upload KMS/HSM architecture + short ownership statement and the backup/restore contact details by 2027-07-05.
- Laura: redacted network exemplars and evidence links (network ACL snapshots) by 2027-07-06.
- Me (Olga): coordinate the CAIQ/ SIG pointers and consolidate the evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx into the intake template; prepare scoping_decision.pdf to accompany the upload.

Notes: HubSpot record HS-83429 will track this engagement; I added AuditCorp as a partner under that record. Drive folder: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-audit-intake.

I'll send a reminder on 2027-07-02 to check progress.

Thanks — keep replies short here so I can forward a clean update to Angela.

Olga
Sr. Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: scoping_decision.pdf)
